ownership.update_protocol: Update only via CarryCtx task with independent docs-curator and security-auditor review, CI green, and explicit provenance record. Risk state changes require per-risk RS-1..RS-7 checklist and auditor sign-off; this file records state, it does not authorize mitigation. Experimental Implementation does not imply Verified or Accepted.
ownership.source_of_truth: This file is the canonical machine-readable source for synchronized revision, snapshot date, maturity, per-risk state, evidence revision/audit references, and sync provenance. Human-readable summaries in README, risk-register, evidence-matrix, TODO, docs/README, release-ladder are derived and validated against it.

notes: Must not auto-accept risks or replace CarryCtx/security review. At M1 Hardening per CTX-0116, R-005/R-006/R-007 are Mitigated at d4d75e9 (5bdcdbd/0afc94d/d4d75e9, Issues #137/#138/#139) per RS-1..RS-7 and independent review; R-004 remains Open at 7a4ee41 with residual platform, UX, and 8192-byte bound-scope limits per audit. Experimental Implementations c0aadd2 (vertical slice), 7e3104d (plugin dogfood), a8735d0 (PTY reply + Kitty) are Implemented (experimental) not Verified/Compatible/Release-ready per Draft -> Experimental Implementation -> Accepted -> Verified -> Compatible ladder. Overall product remains Pre-alpha, not Verified/Compatible/Release-ready. Test counts are per audit/implementation evidence, not duplicated here unless generated via cargo test.
